name: Autocomplete Location Field for Contact Form 7
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Autocomplete Location Field for Contact Form 7 is the easiest way to add a smart Google Address Autocomplete field to any Contact Form 7 form on your WordPress website.

Powered by the Google Places API, this plugin delivers real-time address suggestions as users type — reducing typos, incomplete submissions, and user frustration. Whether you run a delivery service, real estate agency, booking platform, or local business, this plugin helps you collect accurate location data effortlessly.

🔗 Pro Version | Support | Get a Google Places API Key

Why Use Autocomplete Location Field for Contact Form 7?

Manually typed addresses are prone to errors. This plugin eliminates that problem by integrating Google’s powerful address intelligence directly into your CF7 forms. Users get instant, accurate suggestions — and you get clean, reliable data.

Perfect for:
– 📦 Delivery and shipping address forms
– 🏠 Real estate and property listing sites
– 📅 Booking and appointment forms
– 🛠️ Service area and local business websites
– 📬 Business contact and inquiry forms

✅ Key Features (Free)

  • Google Address Autocomplete — Real-time suggestions powered by Google Places API
  • Seamless CF7 Integration — Works natively inside the Contact Form 7 editor
  • Simple API Key Setup — Connect your Google API key in minutes
  • Lightweight & Optimized — Minimal impact on page load speed
  • Easy Field Insertion — Add the autocomplete field with a single click in the CF7 editor

🚀 Pro Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced location control:

  • 🌍 Country Restriction — Limit autocomplete suggestions to specific countries (e.g. US, UK, AU)
  • 🗺️ Google Map Display — Show an interactive map when a location is selected
  • 🧩 Separate Address Components — Capture Street, City, State, Country, and Postcode in individual fields
  • 🏷️ Place Type Filtering — Restrict suggestions by type (e.g. establishments, geocodes, art galleries)
  • 🌐 Custom Placeholder Translation — Localize your field placeholder text
  • ⚡ Priority Support — Get fast, dedicated help from our team

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Navigate to Contact → Google Place API in your WordPress admin.
  3. Paste your Google Places API Key.
  4. Open any Contact Form 7 form editor.
  5. Click “Field Autocomplete” to insert the location field shortcode.
  6. Save the form and publish your page.

That’s it — your form now has intelligent address autocomplete!

  • Pro Version: codesmade.com/store
  • API Key Guide: codesmade.com/create-google-map-place-api-key
sections.installation:
Option 1: Install via WordPress Admin (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Autocomplete Location Field for Contact Form 7”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Navigate to Contact → Google Place API and enter your API key.

Option 2: Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  4. Add your Google API key under Contact → Google Place API.
  5. Open a Contact Form 7 form and insert the Field Autocomplete tag.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google API key to use this plugin?

Yes. A valid Google Places API key is required. You can generate one for free at Google Cloud Console. Make sure the Places API is enabled and billing is set up in your project.

How do I add the autocomplete field to my form?

Open your Contact Form 7 form editor and click the “Field Autocomplete” button in the tag generator toolbar. The shortcode will be inserted automatically.

The autocomplete is not showing suggestions. How do I fix it?

Open your browser’s developer tools (F12) and check the Console tab for errors. Common causes include:
– Incorrect or missing API key
– Places API not enabled in Google Cloud Console
– Billing not activated on your Google Cloud account

Can I restrict autocomplete results to a specific country?

Yes — country restriction is available in the Pro version.

Can I capture address parts like city, state, and postcode in separate fields?

Yes — separate address components are a Pro feature.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes. The plugin is tested up to WordPress 6.9.1 and actively maintained.

Where can I get support?

Visit our support page at codesmade.com/contact-us or post in the WordPress support forum.
